auditor: 6 parallel agents (vuln / bug / qa) over two scopes, each finding verified in-code by the lead before inclusion
scope: pay-over-whatsapp (billing pay-link -> notification-service WhatsApp -> public redirector)

verdict_legend.CONFIRMED: reproduced/verified in code by the lead; a real defect or gap
verdict_legend.CONFIRMED_LATENT: real but not currently reachable/exploitable given a stated precondition
verdict_legend.NEEDS_DECISION: real, but the fix reshapes a deliberate design/contract or spans all gateway adapters — owner decides
verdict_legend.ACCEPTED: already documented and consciously accepted in code; no action
verdict_legend.FALSE_POSITIVE: not a real issue on verification

by_verdict.note: FIN-008 and FIN-023 are the same reconcile gap seen at core and route layer

summary.headline: No CRITICAL. Two HIGH money-loss bugs both localized to billing _claw_back (refund reversal misses cart/consolidated grants and the top-up fund). One HIGH authz inconsistency (global plan/coupon creation reachable by tenant-scoped billing.manage). Payments-service core is very strong; gaps there are route/adapter test coverage and one stale-amount link reuse.

findings.title: _claw_back reverses nothing for cart / consolidated / hosted-cart invoices (grants in meta['grants'])
findings.scenario: A cart of 2 plans (each +1000 credits) is paid -> meta['grants']=[{subA,1000},{subB,1000}], no grant_minor. Full refund -> _claw_back reads grant_minor=0 and returns; customer keeps 2000 credits AND the money back. Same for every consolidated renewal invoice later voided/charged-back.
findings.evidence: grantable = int((inv.meta or {}).get('grant_minor', 0) or 0); if grantable <= 0: return
findings.verification_note: _mark_paid grants from BOTH grant_minor (single) and meta['grants'] (checkout/consolidated/cart), but _claw_back and grants._grantable read only grant_minor. record_clawback keys on clawback_source_for(invoice) with no discriminator, so N per-sub reversals would need a discriminator.

findings.title: _claw_back debits the wrong fund (ignores per-invoice grant_fund override)
findings.scenario: wallet_topup credits fund 'topup' via meta.grant_fund. Refunding the top-up reaches _claw_back which debits self._cfg['grant_fund'] (e.g. 'credits') instead of 'topup' -> wrong fund driven negative / clawback fails, customer keeps the refunded top-up balance.
findings.verification_note: _mark_paid credit uses fund=(inv.meta or {}).get('grant_fund') or self._cfg['grant_fund'] (line ~1795); reversal must mirror it.

findings.title: run_overage idempotency key (%Y-%m) can collide across two periods in one calendar month
findings.scenario: A prorated partial first period + first full period whose current_period_start fall in the same %Y-%m share the overage key; the second period's overage is skipped (dropped charge).
findings.verification_note: run_cycle correctly keys on int(current_period_end); overage should key on int(current_period_start) to match.

findings.title: Wallet idempotency keys not length-prefixed (tenant|source boundary ambiguity)
findings.scenario: If a tenant id could contain '|', tenant 'a'+source 'b|c' and tenant 'a|b'+source 'c' collide on 'a|b|c' (cross-tenant idempotency aliasing). payments-service length-prefixes the trusted part; wallet does not.
findings.verification_note: Not reachable: tenant ids are system-assigned and '|'-free. Changing the key format is risky (would orphan existing durable *_SEEN markers -> a redelivered old credit could double-credit during transition, cf. the v0.25.6 AAD incident). Defer unless a migration ships with it.

fix.note: Length-prefixed idempotency keys ({len}:{tenant}|…) in _claim/_finalize/_CREDIT_SEEN/_SPEND_SEEN, with a READ-ONLY legacy fallback so pre-upgrade markers/claims still dedupe (no double money op across deploy). Migration-safe; real tenant ids are '|'-free so the legacy fallback can't collide.

findings.title: Tenant-scoped billing.manage can create GLOBAL plans + coupons (edit twins are correctly platform-only)
findings.scenario: If billing.manage is issued tenant-scoped (the code's own comment says it may be), a tenant operator POSTs a public 100%-off coupon then subscribes for 0.00, and injects global plans onto /public/plans and /offers for every tenant. create_plan/coupon CRUD are _ADMIN (platform.billing OR billing.manage) while update_plan and discount-rules are _PLATFORM only.
findings.verification_note: Plans and coupons are global (no tenant field). Gating create_plan + coupon CRUD to _PLATFORM matches the already platform-only edits and closes the escalation; platform staff hold platform.billing so no legitimate flow breaks. Peers create scoped coupons via the internal create_scoped_coupon route.

findings.title: Platform-wide dunning sweep triggerable by tenant-scoped billing.manage
findings.scenario: dunning_sweep() runs across ALL tenants; the user route is _ADMIN (no _guard), so a tenant admin can drive the fleet-wide dunning pass. Idempotent, but unexpected fleet charge attempts / gateway load.
findings.verification_note: The internal twin is correctly require_internal_token. Fix = make the user route _PLATFORM.

findings.title: Wallet payout HTTP routes (withdraw / settle / reclaim) have no integration test
findings.scenario: Core is unit-tested but the route layer that moves money OUT of the platform is not: a router that defaulted/omitted the mandatory withdraw source, mis-mapped an error, or dropped auth would ship with no failing test.

findings.title: reconcile() cross-tenant guard and EXPIRED-recovery branch untested
findings.scenario: reconcile() is only driven via the sweep on PENDING rows. Its own cross-tenant guard (tenant mismatch -> None) and EXPIRED re-query branch are unexercised; tightening either would silently stop recovering after-expiry money / lose the IDOR guard with no failing test.
findings.evidence: if row is None or row.get('tenant') != tenant: return None   # untested branch

findings.title: refund() REFUND_AMOUNT_INVALID (amount <= 0) branch untested
findings.scenario: A zero/negative explicit refund amount is a plausible caller bug; the guard is unverified, so a regression letting 0 reach the gateway would not be caught.
findings.evidence: no test references REFUND_AMOUNT_INVALID (only REFUND_EXCEEDS_OUTSTANDING / already_refunded)

findings.title: Redirector 410 branches untested (expired link mark_expired; spent/terminal generic refusal)
findings.scenario: A regression that 302'd a completed/failed/expired link to the gateway, or that leaked the concrete terminal state, would pass CI. Only the happy 302 + unknown-id 404 + http-downgrade refusal are tested.
findings.evidence: no test for is_expired->mark_expired->410 nor the terminal-refusal path

findings.title: Wallet zero-amount credit/spend/reserve edges not asserted
findings.scenario: validate_credit permits amount=0; spend(net=0)/reserve(net=0) have no test. A zero credit still writes a ledger row + permanent-floor entry (before the zero filter). Behaviour unverified (not a money-loss path).

findings.title: DNS-rebind window on tenant-controlled gateway base
findings.scenario: guard_fetch_url resolves+checks IPs but urllib re-resolves at connect (TOCTOU); a tenant-set MERCHANT_API_BASE could resolve public then connect to an internal IP.
findings.evidence: code comment: '(A resolve->connect DNS-rebind window remains; acceptable for a server-to-server gateway call where the host is a stored credential, not live request input.)'
findings.verification_note: Base is set only via internal token AND validated https/non-private at write; redirects blocked. Consciously documented as accepted.

fix.note: DNS-rebind closed: resolve+validate once, then CONNECT to the pinned IP (custom http.client HTTPS/HTTP connection) with SNI+cert+Host on the real hostname. No re-resolve at connect.

findings.title: Redirector existence oracle (404 unknown vs 410 exists-but-unusable)
findings.scenario: A holder can distinguish exists vs not via status code.
findings.verification_note: Tokens are 128/256-bit; enumeration infeasible; terminal states are indistinguishable from each other. Accepted.

fix.note: Existence oracle closed: the payments redirector returns an IDENTICAL 404 + one generic body for unknown AND existing-but-unusable; only a live link 302s.

findings.title: resolve_pay_link proceeds (returns checkout_url) when the invoice row is missing
findings.scenario: A pay-link whose invoice was hard-deleted still 302s to the live gateway page; intent ('dead once the invoice is not open') is not enforced for the missing-invoice case.
findings.evidence: blocks only when 'inv_row is not None and status != open'
findings.verification_note: Low impact (completion needs the invoice), but should fail closed on a missing invoice.

findings.title: A partial gateway refund webhook voids the WHOLE invoice and claws ALL grants
findings.scenario: Merchant issues a partial dashboard refund (20 of 100). Tap/Geidea sends status REFUNDED -> _apply_outcome treats it as full: refunded_minor=total, invoice void, full clawback. Books show a 100 refund that never happened; customer loses all credit for a partial refund.
findings.evidence: comment: 'A gateway refund webhook carries no partial amount here -> it is a FULL refund of whatever remains'; WebhookEvent has no amount field (tap.py)
findings.verification_note: Documented intentional; a correct fix requires threading a refund amount through WebhookEvent across ALL gateway adapters (Tap/Geidea/Stripe/PayPal/...). Cross-adapter design change - surface to owner before building.

fix.note: Generic across ALL gateways: WebhookEvent.refunded_minor populated by every adapter (tap/stripe/moyasar/checkout/geidea/paypal/paytabs/aps/hyperpay) from its own signed refund payload; _apply_outcome applies a cumulative-floor amount-based refund — partial keeps the invoice paid, full voids, replay no-ops, 0/absent falls back to full. Shapes verified 2026-09-26 vs provider docs.

findings.title: Billing webhook marks invoice paid without verifying captured amount
findings.scenario: A validly-signed webhook reporting a captured amount lower than the invoice total still marks the full invoice paid, records a full charge, grants full credit, activates the sub. payments-service enforces amount_ok+currency_ok; billing does not.
findings.evidence: if kind=='payment.succeeded' ... await self._mark_paid(inv)  # no amount compare
findings.verification_note: Same root as FIN-015: WebhookEvent carries no amount, so verification needs a cross-adapter change (populate + compare amount, or verify-by-fetch_status before marking paid). Surface to owner.

findings.title: create_link reuses an existing link for the same reference WITHOUT revalidating amount/currency
findings.scenario: Order R link minted at 100 SAR. Order edited to 150; shop calls create again with reference='R', amount=15000. Service silently returns the stale 100 SAR link -> shop under-collects, no error.
findings.evidence: existing = await self._req.active_by_reference(...); if existing is not None: return self._to_link(existing)
findings.verification_note: Idempotency key is (tenant, reference) only. Fix: on reuse, if existing.amount_minor/currency differ from the request, refuse (409 REQUEST_AMOUNT_MISMATCH) rather than return the stale link.

findings.title: TuwaiqPay webhook re-query passes no currency; an absent status currency can mis-mark a real success as FAILED
findings.scenario: A real SETTLED webhook whose status response omits bill.currency yields cur='' -> apply_outcome currency_ok False -> FAILED with amount_mismatch.
findings.verification_note: Self-heals: reconcile passes row.currency and a later SUCCEEDED supersedes FAILED via CAS. Adapter has no request row to source currency from at webhook time; low priority. Optional hardening only.

findings.title: WhatsApp template buttons hardcode index '0'; multiple dynamic buttons in one send collide
findings.scenario: If a send supplies more than one dynamic button component (e.g. quick_reply + url), both are emitted at index '0', which Meta rejects/misroutes. (b) An empty url suffix is a falsy-guard drop -> the button falls back to its fixed base URL (a pay link with no token).
findings.verification_note: Index-per-button is a clean correctness fix (assign by order). The empty-suffix falsy-drop matches the file's documented 'declared only when supplied' discipline (empty == not supplied); left as-is.

findings.title: Dead assertion masks the wrong-secret webhook rejection ('test that stops testing')
findings.scenario: 'assert ... is not None or True' always passes. If wrong-secret verification regressed to accepting a forged body, this line would not catch it (only the incidental event-count check partially covers).
findings.evidence: assert await svc.handle_webhook(...) is not None or True

findings.title: TuwaiqPay verify_webhook (the only production money gate) has no test
findings.scenario: The unsigned-webhook-re-query trust contract is untested: trusts only transactionId then re-queries fetch_status; verified only on a terminal fetched status; missing id / GatewayUnavailable -> unverified. A regression trusting the POSTed status would ship silently.
findings.evidence: test_tuwaiqpay_adapter.py covers fetch_status/prepare_checkout but never verify_webhook

findings.title: Billing public redirector route has no integration test (incl. open-redirect defense)
findings.scenario: The host-allowlist branch (503 when unset, 502 CHECKOUT_HOST_NOT_ALLOWED) could regress to an open redirect with no failing test. Only resolve_pay_link core is tested, not the route's status mapping.

findings.title: Payments reconcile HTTP route untested
findings.scenario: 502 GATEWAY_UNAVAILABLE / 404 wrong-tenant / happy 'recover missed webhook -> completes' at the HTTP layer are unproven; reconcile only exercised via the sweep core.

findings.title: TuwaiqPay prepare_checkout / auth failure branches untested
findings.scenario: Missing customerName/phone -> ok=False; bill code==0 or empty link -> ok=False; _access_token auth failure -> GatewayUnavailable; token caching. A regression minting an ok=True-but-linkless session would strand a claim / hand out a broken link.
findings.evidence: test_tuwaiqpay_adapter.py:57 covers only the happy prepare_checkout

findings.title: Webhook route actual-body oversize branch untested (only declared content-length is)
findings.scenario: The len(body) > max_bytes guard when content-length is absent/understated has no test; a memory-pressure bypass via a lying header could regress.

findings.title: Console gateway empty-webhook-secret fail-closed untested
findings.scenario: No test drives an empty secret to assert it never verifies. It is the pattern real adapters copy; the empty-signing-secret fail-closed case is in scope.

findings.title: Webhook route broad-except (200 {applied:false}) anti-retry-storm path untested
findings.scenario: A regression that 500'd (retry storm) or hid the error when handle_webhook raises would not be caught.
findings.evidence: no test forces handle_webhook to raise

findings.title: Amount/currency mismatch not exercised at a non-exponent-2 currency (latent)
findings.scenario: SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES is SAR/USD/EUR (all exp-2); a 3-dp currency can't reach apply_outcome today. If the set is widened to KWD/BHD without a mismatch test at that exponent, the minor-unit compare is unproven for it.

fix.note: Amount compare proven at a 3-dp currency (KWD) via direct apply_outcome tests (match + 1-fils mismatch).

findings.title: TuwaiqPay adapter status-currency-absent path (mis-mark) has no regression test
findings.scenario: Pairs with FIN-018: no test proves the webhook path stays unverified/self-heals when bill.currency is absent.
findings.evidence: no test for the currency-absent fetch_status branch

well_covered_confirmed_correct: Money math: Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP for VAT/coupon/rule/proration; currency exponents (KWD/BHD/OMR 3dp, JPY 0dp) via Decimal; no float tails.
Discount composition: MAX(coupon, rule), never summed, both clamped to subtotal.

Idempotency/crash windows: wallet _mutate single CAS + staged ledger _flush replay; marker-first ordering with rollback + durable *_SEEN backstops; billing run_cycle/consolidated/checkout/start_*_checkout/credit claim-before-mutate, mark-before-advance, replay-completes-advance.
payments-service apply_outcome: version-pinned CAS, server-authoritative amount+currency (refuses 0/absent as unverifiable), success-supersedes-non-success only, webhook+reconcile share one seam.
Webhook empty-secret forgery: fail-closed in both billing and payments; tenant binding + event dedupe + Stripe replay window.
Redirectors: https + host-allowlist fail-closed (empty allowlist permits nothing); single-use per invoice; TTL/terminal refusal.
Entitlement resolver: fails closed on lapsed period, scales quantity into rich limit dicts (v0.25.32), grandfathers per-row before merge; merge refuses unknown strategy / mixed kind.
Secrets/PII: operator secret routes write-only; tokens never echoed; audit resource= uses subject_ref pseudonyms; conduit never carries card/PAN data; WhatsApp privacy mode fails closed to private.

v0.25.33.note: All 8 HIGH fixed with deep per-unit tests; companion LOWs FIN-006/FIN-014 and MEDIUM FIN-024 bundled. FIN-008 covered at the route layer by FIN-023 tests. Full suites green (billing 1074, wallet 367, payments 458), 55 gates + OpenAPI.

needs_decision: FIN-016 billing webhook amount verification (both need WebhookEvent to carry an amount across ALL gateway adapters)
deferred_migration: FIN-004 wallet key length-prefix (changing the durable *_SEEN key format needs a migration or it orphans markers -> a double-credit window; latent since tenant ids are '|'-free)
latent: FIN-028 amount/currency mismatch at a 3dp currency (unreachable: create-gate blocks non exp-2 currencies)

batch-2-2026-09-26.verification: billing 1076, wallet 372, payments 465, notification 755; 55 gates + OpenAPI all green.

batch-3-2026-09-26.decision: Researched Stripe/PSP best practice: verify the amount, but from the GATEWAY (fetch_status), not the webhook body. Chose option (a)-goal via (b)-mechanism — one central change in billing, no per-adapter touch.
batch-3-2026-09-26.FIN-016: FIXED — _apply_outcome refuses to mark an invoice paid unless the gateway's authoritative amount (pulled via fetch_status by both the webhook and reconcile paths) matches the invoice total+currency. Underpayment/overpayment/gateway-not-confirmed are refused (invoice stays open, payment flagged, logged). 0/absent amount = unverifiable -> proceed with a WARNING. 7 tests.
batch-3-2026-09-26.FIN-015: PARTIAL — see finding note; needs per-adapter refunded-amount, deferred by the no-adapter-touch decision.

batch-4-2026-09-26.FIN-015: FIXED generically across all 9 gateway adapters + core _apply_outcome (cumulative-floor). 21 new tests (7 core partial/full/bounds/idempotency + 8 per-adapter extraction + 6 amount-verify from FIN-016).
batch-4-2026-09-26.status: All 29 audit findings now resolved except: FIN-004 (latent, needs migration) and FIN-028 (latent, unreachable) — both documented.
